newsitem.title: INDIA: India to simplify tax laws to improve compliance.
newsitem.headline: India to simplify tax laws to improve compliance.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday that the government would introduce a bill to simplify income tax laws in the winter session of parliament.
The bill will incorporate suggestions of an expert panel and be opened to public comment before being introduced to parliament, a government statement quoted Chidambaram as saying.
"The Finance Minister said that the main purpose of this exercise is to have a low rate of taxation, automaticity of compliance and selective interference by the government," the statement said
The government is also thinking of framing comprehensive service tax laws to guide the tax payers, it added.
Chidambaram lowered the peak rate of income tax to 30 percent from 40 in the budget for the fiscal year ending March 31 1998, approved by parliament last week.
